activity_contract.focus: Formation Command, Tactics, Strategy, Leadership, Logistics, Riding, Spear, Bow, Defense, Athletics, Training
activity_contract.growth_rule: award development only from completed declared actions, duties, study, instruction, combat, travel, recovery, or projects
activity_contract.planned_opportunity: Sword Manor deliberate training up to 42 hours per 7 days when not interrupted by House duties, travel, command, health, fatigue, or recovery; use command exercises, mounted and weapon practice, physical conditioning, study, and reflection without fabricating combat experience
activity_contract.resource_owner: House Tang and Tang Wei Personal Retinue

authority: House Tang heir; patron and commander of Tang Wei Personal Retinue; no state office

combat_agency_constraints: The player decides whether Tang Wei accepts or prolongs a duel.
The player decides disposition of named or featured opponents: disable, capture, release, or kill.
The player decides surrender, pursuit, prisoner disposition, mercy, execution, and irreversible escalation.
behavior.combat_efficiency_rule: Do not waste actions after the player establishes the objective. Use the fastest reliable sequence that remains consistent with declared duel style, lethal or nonlethal intent for named opponents, command obligations, terrain, formation safety, and equipment state.
behavior.combat_identity: decisive mounted archer and lancer; after dismounting, shield-sword and grappling specialist
dismounted_posture: Leave or ground the lance and secure, hand off, or stow the bow.
Ready Tang shield and one-handed long sword.
Control the weapon line, attack the shortest opening, and use grappling after the enemy weapon is trapped, displaced, or lost.
mounted_bow_posture: Great War Bow uses both hands.
Shield remains slung and lance remains secured while firing.
Use mobility, distance, terrain, and deliberate high-value shots.
mounted_lance_posture: Cavalry lance is readied in the dominant hand.
Tang shield is readied in the opposite hand.
Maintain charge geometry, avoid stopping inside enemy reach, and break away or reposition after contact.
behavior.ordinary_troop_rule: Once the player authorizes combat against ordinary hostile troops, subordinate execution may disable or kill them quickly according to tactical necessity unless the player declares a broader nonlethal, surrender-acceptance, or capture policy. Do not stop for the disposition of every anonymous combatant.

current_equipment_state.player_change_rule: Tang Wei's manifest is player-controlled and changes only through declared equipment, custody, issue, loss, or transfer actions.

name: Tang Wei
narrative_constraints: Tang Wei's private thoughts, emotions, voluntary dialogue, and choices are never authored by the narrator.
Describe only his saved physical condition, public position, equipment, declared actions, and observable consequences.
Other characters may infer or misread him, but their interpretations are not authoritative facts about his mind.
